name: Octopus
soul: The soul of one who is holding more than anyone knows, and still has a hand free for you.
spark: The mote is in your pocket, then your sleeve, then the drawer you locked. Twice it has undone your bootlaces to see how they were done.

hybrid.text: It has an arm on everything in the room, and one of them is on your shoulder.

settled.name: Inkling
settled.text: An octopus the size of your thumb, in your cup, your boot, your inkwell. It has not chosen a colour, and tries all of yours in an evening.
settled.sign: No bigger than a thumb and nearly clear, with two gold eyes that are already working something out.
settled.habit: It climbs into whatever you have just put down, and looks out of it.

paths.name: Many-hands
paths.of: one who is holding everyone's things and has not put one of them down
paths.text: It learned from you that somebody has to carry it all. It has the lamp, the cup, the coats and your hand, and an arm to spare.
paths.sign: Round and warm-coloured, with every arm full: a lamp, a cup, somebody's coat. One arm is always empty, held a little toward you.
paths.habit: It takes things out of people's hands before they know they are tired of holding them.

prongs.name: Cup-bearer
prongs.of: one who has the cup in your hand before you have asked for it
prongs.text: You are hurt, and there is a cup in your hand. It was holding it ready before the blow landed.
prongs.sign: It holds a steaming cup level in one raised arm whatever the other seven are doing, and never spills it.
prongs.habit: It warms a cup against its own skin and leaves it where you will reach next.

finishes.name: Splint-and-Sling
finishes.of: one who sets what is broken and stays until it has knit
finishes.text: It winds an arm round what is broken in you and holds it still, and does not let go until it will bear weight.
finishes.sign: Two of its arms are bound straight as splints and it stands on them. A third hangs in a sling it tied itself.
finishes.habit: It straightens pictures, collars, and the blankets of the sick.

finishes.name: The Last Served
finishes.of: one who feeds the whole table and eats what is left, standing
finishes.text: It serves eight at once and has never sat down to a meal. After a fight it is already going round with the bowl.
finishes.sign: A ladle in one arm, bowls stacked down three more, and a pot it carries by the rim against its own skin.
finishes.habit: It counts the bowls back in, and frets over the one that comes back full.

prongs.name: Hand-in-the-dark
prongs.of: one who takes your hand where you cannot see, and says nothing about it
prongs.text: In the dark there is a cool hand in yours. It has one for each of the party, and has not lost anybody yet.
prongs.sign: It goes pale in the dark so that it can be found, and keeps an arm stretched out to each side, feeling for a shoulder.
prongs.habit: At lights-out it touches each bed in the dormitory once, in order, with the tip of one arm.

finishes.name: Lifeline
finishes.of: one who makes of everyone a chain that nothing drops out of
finishes.text: It links the party arm to arm through the worst of the deep places. Nobody has yet let go, because it will not.
finishes.sign: Its arms are knotted to one another end to end in one long line, with a loop left open at each end for a hand.
finishes.habit: On stairs it goes last, with an arm on the rail and an arm on each of you.

finishes.name: Holdfast
finishes.of: one who held on to somebody past the point of sense, and was right to
finishes.text: It has had hold of each of your classmates once when they would have fallen. It remembers which arm.
finishes.sign: One arm is far longer than the rest and ringed with old grip-marks, and that is the one it offers.
finishes.habit: It will not let go of a hand first. People have learned to say when.

prongs.name: Plate-spinner
prongs.of: one who keeps eight things in the air and lets no one see the effort
prongs.text: It learned your Pattern's beat and keeps it with whatever is to hand. Nothing it has thrown has yet come down wrong.
prongs.sign: Rings of light turn above its lifted arms, one over each, and its eyes are on none of them.
prongs.habit: It keeps small things turning in the air while it thinks: buttons, coins, your keys.

finishes.name: Eight-at-once
finishes.of: one who does eight things at once and all of them properly
finishes.text: Each arm is at a different piece of work and none waits on another. When your Pattern fires it has already laid out what comes next.
finishes.sign: Every arm holds a different tool and works at it, spread wide like the spokes of a wheel.
finishes.habit: It writes, stirs, mends and turns a page at once, and gets cross if watched.

finishes.name: Mended Plate
finishes.of: one who let one thing fall, once, and has never forgiven it
finishes.text: It dropped something once that mattered. Now one arm does nothing but hold a mended plate, and the other seven work twice as hard.
finishes.sign: One arm holds up a plate with a bright seam where it was mended. It will not put it down or let anyone take it.
finishes.habit: It checks its hold on everything, twice, starting with the plate.

paths.name: Latch-lifter
paths.of: one who cannot leave a closed thing closed, or stay in one
paths.text: It learned from you that every shut thing is a question. It has been out of its jar since the first night, and into everything else.
paths.sign: Long thin arms with tips as fine as wire, always feeling along an edge. A ring of keys hangs on one, none of them yours.
paths.habit: It undoes every knot and buckle within reach and does most of them up again, differently.

prongs.name: Bottle-dweller
prongs.of: one who can fit themselves into whatever room they are given
prongs.text: It goes into a bottle, a boot, a gap under a door. The blow meant for it finds the place it was, and glass.
prongs.sign: It lives in a bottle a third its size, with one eye at the neck and its arms folded in like letters.
prongs.habit: It tries every vessel in the room for size, and sleeps in the smallest.

finishes.name: Bottle-post
finishes.of: one who gets word out of anywhere they are shut in
finishes.text: Shut it in and the word still gets out: a note on the tide, in a corked bottle, in its own hand.
finishes.sign: A corked bottle with a rolled paper in it rides high in one arm, and another arm is always writing the next.
finishes.habit: It leaves notes in corked bottles in the wash-basins, addressed to nobody.

finishes.name: Ship-in-the-bottle
finishes.of: one who builds something whole in the small room they were given
finishes.text: It built a ship inside its bottle, mast by mast, through the neck. It lives in the hold and is entirely content.
finishes.sign: It carries a great bottle on its back with a ship in it, every sail set, and a gold eye at the stern window.
finishes.habit: It rigs things: thread between bedposts, string across the washstand, all of it taut.

prongs.name: Key-turner
prongs.of: one who has to see how a thing was fastened before they can leave it
prongs.text: Every lock on the line is a small argument, and it has won them all. It carries the answers on its arms.
prongs.sign: Each arm ends in a different key, grown that way, and it holds them fanned like a hand of cards.
prongs.habit: It locks and unlocks the same door until it is satisfied with the sound.

finishes.name: Points-turner
finishes.of: one who throws the switch that sends the trouble down another track
finishes.text: It works the points of a junction with eight arms and sends what was coming for you down the siding.
finishes.sign: It sits atop a signal lever with an arm on each of the others, under a small lamp that shows the field's colour.
finishes.habit: It rearranges your boots by the door into the order it thinks they will be needed.

finishes.name: Skeleton Key
finishes.of: one before whom no door stays shut, and who is trusted with that
finishes.text: There is nothing it cannot open, and it has been told so. It opens what you ask and has never once gone further.
finishes.sign: Thin as wire and pale as bone, with one long arm let straight down that ends in a single plain key.
finishes.habit: It tries the door of every room it passes, finds it locked, and nods.

prongs.name: Shell-carrier
prongs.of: one who makes a house of whatever is lying about, wherever they are put down
prongs.text: It walks on two arms and carries two halves of a shell in the rest. When the blow comes it is inside, and the shell is shut.
prongs.sign: It carries the two halves of a great shell, one either side, and tiptoes on the tips of two arms like someone late.
prongs.habit: It collects lids. Any two things that might shut together are tried, and kept if they do.

finishes.name: Wall-gardener
finishes.of: one who builds a low wall round what they love and tends what grows there
finishes.text: It has walled its ground with shells and stones, one at a time, and something is growing inside. It will show you if you ask twice.
finishes.sign: A low ring of shells and bright stones goes round it like a wall, and a small green thing grows in the middle.
finishes.habit: It brings back one stone from every place you go, and each has its place in the wall.

finishes.name: Borrowed Helm
finishes.of: one who goes into the worst of it wearing whatever was to hand
finishes.text: It found a soldier's helmet in a ruin and has worn it since. What comes down on the two of you rings on iron.
finishes.sign: An old dented helmet sits on it like a house, with two gold eyes under the brim and its arms below like a beard.
finishes.habit: It tries on hats. Yours, the Instructors', the cook's. It has opinions about all of them.

paths.name: Sleeps-on-it
paths.of: one who works a thing out asleep, and wakes knowing
paths.text: It learned from you that some things are only solved by leaving them. Colours cross its skin as it sleeps, and in the morning it knows.
paths.sign: Its eyes are half shut and slow bands of colour pass down it, like thought seen from outside. Two small fins beat above its eyes.
paths.habit: It sleeps on your open book, and the page it has moved to is the one you needed.

prongs.name: Tide-teller
prongs.of: one who knows when a thing will turn, having watched it turn before
prongs.text: It has the foe's rhythm the way it has the tide's. Its skin goes pale a breath before the strike: guard when it does.
prongs.sign: It hangs like a bell with its arms let straight down in a row, and pale marks light down each in turn like the hours.
prongs.habit: It taps out the hours on the window with one arm, and is never wrong.

finishes.name: Slack-water
finishes.of: one who waits for the still moment between two tides, and acts in it
finishes.text: Between the foe's blow and its next there is a stillness. It lives there, and holds the moment open for you.
finishes.sign: It hangs perfectly still, its web spread between its arms like a parasol, and the air round it does not move.
finishes.habit: It stops, entirely, for a breath at the top of every hour.

finishes.name: Storm-glass
finishes.of: one who feels the weather of a room change before anyone has spoken
finishes.text: It clouds before trouble like a storm-glass. When it goes dark from the arms upward, something is coming that you have not seen.
finishes.sign: It has drawn itself up tall and gone clear as glass, and something like weather moves inside: cloud, and a small light.
finishes.habit: It clouds over before a quarrel, and goes and sits by whoever is about to start it.

prongs.name: Ink-hand
prongs.of: one who must write a thing down before they know what they think
prongs.text: What it worked out in the night it writes on the air in its own ink, and the ink hangs there long enough to read.
prongs.sign: A slow cloud of ink hangs by it in the shape of the last thing it thought, and one arm is black to the elbow.
prongs.habit: It writes on fogged windows, in spilt salt, in the dust on a shelf. Mostly sums.

finishes.name: Ink-blot
finishes.of: one who knows the one true thing and cannot make it plainer than a blot
finishes.text: It knows where the foe will be and can only show you in a blot. Learn to read its blots: they have not been wrong.
finishes.sign: The ink round it never clears. Two eyes look out of the cloud, and sometimes the outline of a thing that has not happened yet.
finishes.habit: It leaves a blot on your pillow most mornings, and waits to see what you make of it.

finishes.name: Fair Copy
finishes.of: one who gets a thing exactly right and then writes it out clean
finishes.text: It has written out everything it knows about each beast you have felled, fair, in eight hands. The book is nearly full.
finishes.sign: It holds a thick book open across four arms and writes in it with two more, very small and very straight.
finishes.habit: It copies out your notes at night in a better hand, and corrects them.

prongs.name: Glass Thinker
prongs.of: one in whom you can see the thought happen, and who does not mind
prongs.text: It has gone clear as glass with thinking. You can watch the idea form in it, a light moving from arm to arm, before it knows itself.
prongs.sign: Clear as glass, its arms turned up like a chandelier, with a small light inside that travels down one and then another.
prongs.habit: It hangs in the window at night with the lamp behind it, so that you can see it is thinking.

finishes.name: Eight Minds
finishes.of: one who is of several minds and has learned to let them all speak
finishes.text: Each of its arms has thought the matter through on its own. They do not agree, and it has learned to hear all eight before you move.
finishes.sign: A separate small light burns at the tip of each arm, held out in a ring, and they dim in turn as if speaking.
finishes.habit: Its arms play one another at knucklebones while its eyes read.

finishes.name: Deep Sleeper
finishes.of: one who goes very far down into a thing and is gone a long while
finishes.text: It goes down into the cold to think and is gone for days. What it brings up is always worth the wait, and it does not hurry.
finishes.sign: Dark as deep water, with a web drawn round its arms like a cloak, great fins, and a single cold light where they meet.
finishes.habit: It goes to the bottom of the rain-butt for days at a time and comes up with something solved.

newFeatures.label: gold eyes with a bar for a pupil
ink it lets go on the air
